title: A Seat at the Table
purpose: Vincent asks the player to take control for one night
setup: Vincent asks you to take control for one night.
briefingObjective: Choose three crew, then one operation in Dusk, Midnight, and Last Call.
risks: The operation you do not choose still leaves a smaller consequence.
summaryResult: You took the chair and finished the first night.

title: The Velvet Door
purpose: Roxie’s club becomes the crew’s temporary headquarters
setup: Roxie’s club becomes the crew’s temporary headquarters.
objective: Use the club without letting the tab run the night.
briefingObjective: Work the club and the society rooms. Preparation costs Cash.
risks: Social rooms add Heat when they are handled loudly.
summaryResult: The club stayed open, and the cash had a cost.

title: The Missing Envelope
setup: An important payment disappears from the crew’s keeping.
objective: Find the envelope without breaking the crew.
briefingObjective: Recover the payment. The way you ask will move loyalty.
risks: A hard question can cost more loyalty than the cash is worth.
summaryResult: The envelope’s absence changed who trusts the table.

title: Blue Lights, Quiet Streets
setup: Pressure rises across the district, and the streets are no longer casual.
objective: Finish the night with Heat under control.
briefingObjective: Keep the crew off the bright streets. Heat is the danger.
risks: A visible hour can push Heat faster than Influence can help.
summaryResult: The district noticed the crew, or it did not.

title: Family Business
purpose: Two crew members disagree about priorities
setup: Bruno and Elias disagree about what the crew should protect first.
objective: Get through the disagreement without splitting the table.
briefingObjective: Bruno wants protection. Elias wants the books. Pairs matter.
risks: A tense pair subtracts from the score. Old partners add one.
summaryResult: The disagreement was managed through the people you paired.

title: A Broken Promise
purpose: An old ally calls in a favor
setup: An old ally calls in a favor the crew once made.
objective: Answer the favor and live with that answer.
briefingObjective: The ally wants an answer. You will choose after Dusk.
risks: Either answer changes Influence, Cash, Heat, or loyalty.
summaryResult: The favor was answered, and the answer remains.

title: The City in Gold
purpose: A high-profile event offers influence and risk
setup: A high-profile night offers Influence, and every job needs two of the crew.
objective: Be seen with the right pair.
briefingObjective: Every operation tonight requires two assigned characters.
risks: The rooms pay Influence and charge Heat when the pair is wrong.
summaryResult: The gold rooms saw a pair, not a solo act.

previousConsequence.favor_honored: The favor you honored is still opening doors.
previousConsequence.favor_refused: The favor you refused is still being counted.

title: The Quiet Driver
purpose: June discovers that someone knows the crew’s routes
setup: June discovers that someone knows the crew’s routes.
objective: Move the crew without teaching the city the map.
briefingObjective: Transport jobs can spend Cash unless June is assigned. Miles can reveal a hint.
summaryResult: The routes were either changed or left exposed.

title: The Bad Ledger
purpose: Elias finds evidence of long-term manipulation
setup: Elias finds evidence that the books have been steered for a long time.
objective: Choose which resource you will spend to answer the ledger.
briefingObjective: After Dusk you must sacrifice either Cash or Influence.
risks: Both answers cost something the ending still counts.
summaryResult: The ledger was answered by a sacrifice.

title: Smoke Before Dawn
setup: The district begins choosing sides before dawn.
briefingObjective: Thresholds are high. Match the suggested skill or spend preparation.
summaryResult: The district chose, and the crew felt the pressure.

previousConsequence.ledger_paid: The cash you spent on the ledger bought a quieter book.
previousConsequence.ledger_burned: Burning the pages cost Influence that this district can feel.

title: All Debts Are Due
purpose: Every earlier alliance produces a consequence
setup: Every earlier alliance produces a consequence tonight.
objective: Face the debts and decide whether the crew stays to the end.
briefingObjective: The favor and the ledger come due. After Dusk you can hold the crew past a Heat crisis.
risks: Heat at 100 ends the story unless that hold is chosen.
summaryResult: The old choices presented their bill.

title: Last Call
purpose: Final confrontation and decision about the crew’s future
setup: The last night decides what the crew is at dawn.
objective: Finish Last Call. The ending is calculated from the campaign.
briefingObjective: Play the last three phases. Influence, Heat, and loyalty choose the ending.
risks: Heat at 100 still ends the campaign early unless the story override is already in place.
summaryResult: Last Call is over. The ending uses the whole campaign.
